note: Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py under the same id and severity; verify_all.py fails if the two sets differ.

ONE_HERO.description: at most one HERO-category node per page; templates with a hero must have exactly one

HERO_FIRST_IN_FLOW.description: the HERO node is the first in-flow node of the page (fixed/runtime nodes take no position)

FOOTER_LAST.description: shell.footer, when present, is the last in-flow node

CTA_BEFORE_FOOTER.description: a node with constraint mustPrecedeFooter sits directly before shell.footer (in-flow order)

ONE_PER_PAGE.description: sections with onePerPage appear at most once; maxPerPage caps repeatable sections; checked on (section, variant)

NO_CONSECUTIVE_SAME_VARIANT.description: the same (section, variant) never appears twice in a row

NO_ADJACENT_SAME_CATEGORY.description: two adjacent in-flow nodes should not share a semantic category

exceptions.chapter.header->chapter.body: header and body are the two halves of one paper card (EDITORIAL->EDITORIAL by design)
exceptions.cta.download-formats->cta.download-forma: print and audiobook cards of the download page

CHAPTER_HEADER_BEFORE_BODY.description: chapter.body requires chapter.header earlier on the page

HOME_ROUTE_ONLY.description: sections with homeRouteOnly (preloader, sound gate, book intro hero) only on route '/'

RUNTIME_NOT_RETRIEVABLE.description: runtime/utility sections (pinned list) are never retrievalEligible; content sections are never marked ineligible

MOTION_BUDGET.description: at most 2 nodes with a looping motion pattern (pulse-loop, spin-loop) per page; the source uses one per page
